# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V8030 dependency_invalid"
description: "An entry of [dependencies] in sakura.toml is malformed (RFC 0003 §1.2, experimental)."
---

An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8030` prints this explanation offline.

An entry of `[dependencies]` in `sakura.toml` is malformed (RFC 0003 §1.2, experimental).
An entry is `name = "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH"`, `name = { version = "…" }`, `name = { path =
"\<relative dir\>" \}` or `name = \{ git = "\<https URL\>", rev = "\<40 hex\>" \}`, each optionally
with `effects = [...]` and `trusted = true`. The message names the cause: a name that is not
`[a-z][a-z0-9_]*` or is `std` or `main`; a floor that is not three numbers (no `*`, ranges,
pre-release or build metadata); both `version` and `path`; a `path` that is absolute; a `git`
without `rev`, or a `rev` that is not a full 40-hex commit hash (a branch or tag is refused); an
unknown key; a value of the wrong type; or a `path` dependency whose own `sakura.toml` names it
differently from its key.

Wrong:

```toml
[dependencies]
util = "*"
```

Fixed:

```toml
[dependencies]
util = { path = "../util" }
```

[`compiler/tests/ui/V8030_dependency_invalid/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V8030_dependency_invalid/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

`main.sak`:

```sakura
// RFC 0003 §1.2: each malformed `[dependencies]` entry is `V8030` at the entry, naming its

// `rev` that is not a full commit hash, and an unknown key (a branch).
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi") }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"

[dependencies]
Http = "1.0.0"
std = "1.0.0"
json = "*"
util = { version = "1.0.0", path = "../util" }
abs = { path = "/opt/abs" }
scraper = { git = "https://github.com/acme/scraper" }
parser = { git = "https://github.com/acme/parser", rev = "main" }
lexer = { git = "https://github.com/acme/lexer", branch = "main" }
```
